description: Find people or organisations with a combinable filter over all fields. filter = { all: [conditions], any: [conditions] } — every 'all' condition must match, and at least one 'any' condition if given. Condition = { field, op, value }: field is a column (e.g. city, created_at, retention_review_at), 'label', 'custom.<key>' or 'organisation' (people: name or id of any linked organisation). Ops by kind — text: eq, neq, contains, not_contains, starts_with, in, empty, not_empty; number: eq, neq, gt, gte, lt, lte, between [a,b]; date: eq, gt, gte, lt, lte, between, last_days N, older_than_days N, next_days N, overdue; boolean: is_true, is_false; list (label, multiselect, organisation): has, has_all, has_none. Or pass saved_filter_id. Returns { total, rows } (rows with labels and custom fields; limit default 50, max 500; offset; sort {field, desc}) or with ids_only=true { total, ids } (up to 20000) for recipient lists and exports.

filter.description: Filter { all: [conditions], any: [conditions] }, each condition { field, op, value }

ids_only.description: Return only { total, ids } (up to 20000), e.g. for recipient lists and exports

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return

offset.description: Number of entries to skip (for paging)

name: search_crm
